concerns.quote: staff members from Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust have placed great reliance upon their interpretation of a patient's intention and / or a patient's denial of ongoing suicidal intention
concerns.hazard: reliance on patient denial of suicidal intent

concerns.quote: The quality of the Trust's own investigation into the circumstances of Mr [name redacted] death. It failed to identify themes of concern. It included many false and inaccurate statements, failed to challenge false assumptions made at the time and introduced new false information which was not taken from any available records

reports.title: Alexander Lyalushko: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: Inadequate review and incident investigation following a death
concerns.hazard: inadequate review and incident investigation following a death

links.explanation: Both reports criticize the Trust's death investigation processes for being inadequate and missing key information. The earlier report focuses on false statements and missed themes, while the later report highlights omitted GP requests, mislabelled findings, and lack of family consultation.
links.earlier_quote: The quality of the Trust's own investigation into the circumstances of Mr [name redacted] death. It failed to identify themes of concern.
links.later_quote: it did not identify that a request from Mr [name redacted] GP in November 2022 for involvement of its service with Mr Lyalushko had not been actioned;
